findings.note: There is no force 4F in this question; the upward force at distance a is 2F (as steps[0] correctly uses: 2F × a = 2Fa). As printed the statement is false (a force 4F at arm a would give 4Fa). The moment values themselves are right, so this is a mislabel in the answer line rather than a wrong result.

notes: All seven step lines check: arms a and 2a for the vertical forces, perpendicular component 3F sin30° = 3F/2 at arm 4a, senses anticlockwise / clockwise / anticlockwise. Both common-mistakes entries produce the numbers they name (12Fa from 3F × 4a). My values agree with the solution's.
